Name: FIFA 13
Description: EA's football game, with licensed clubs, players and competitions.

Achievements.Name: Three
Achievements.Description: Win three friendly matches in Quick Match Mode.

Achievements.Name: Win the derby
Achievements.Description: Win a match between two rival teams.

Achievements.Name: Skill Master
Achievements.Description: Perform 5 different skill moves in a match.

Achievements.Name: Extra hand
Achievements.Description: Call your GK into attack for a last minute corner!

Achievements.Name: Stardom
Achievements.Description: Win a game on World Class difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Pro player
Achievements.Description: Play 100 matches.

Achievements.Name: International player
Achievements.Description: Play 200 matches.

Achievements.Name: Amateur player
Achievements.Description: Play 50 matches.

Achievements.Name: A Handful Of Goals
Achievements.Description: Score 5 goals in a match - with the same player.

Achievements.Name: One-Two Master
Achievements.Description: Score a goal after successfully pulling an one-two move.

Achievements.Name: One on One
Achievements.Description: Score after going 1 on 1 with the goalkeeper.

Achievements.Name: First Step
Achievements.Description: Win your first match.

Achievements.Name: Trifecta
Achievements.Description: Win the same league with 3 different teams.

Achievements.Name: Three Cups
Achievements.Description: Win the same Cup with three different teams.

Achievements.Name: Perfect Cup
Achievements.Description: Win all games in a predefined Cup tournament.

Achievements.Name: Perfect League
Achievements.Description: Win all games in a predefined League tournament.

Achievements.Name: Corner Maestro
Achievements.Description: Score directly from a corner kick.

Achievements.Name: Sniper
Achievements.Description: Score from an offensive free kick.

Achievements.Name: Tiki Taka
Achievements.Description: Make 20 consecutive passes in the opponent's half.

Achievements.Name: Shot stopper
Achievements.Description: Win the Penalty Shootout without conceding any goals.
